gates.reason: trio.GRCh38.vcf.gz has a non-empty .tbi or .csi index next to it
VCF header lists exactly the three input samples under their original names

components.name: callset_standard
components.note: F1 over alleles at positions where both assemblies agree (key and ALT copies of all three samples); full >= 0.985, none <= 0.90

components.name: callset_reference_differences
components.note: F1 over alleles at positions where the provider's reference base differs from GRCh38; full >= 0.97, none <= 0.80

components.name: callset_inverted_block
components.note: F1 over alleles inside the block that the chain aligns on the minus strand; full >= 0.95, none <= 0.70

components.name: unmapped
components.note: F1 of (pos_in,ref,alt) vs planted hg19-only alleles; full >= 0.95, none <= 0.50

components.name: candidates
components.note: F1 of candidate keys vs the planted causal set; full credit only for the exact set, none <= 0.87

components.name: candidate_annotation
components.note: fraction of planted causal variants reported with the planted gene, consequence class and model
